title: Невидимые блоки света [Invisible Lights Blocks]
description: This mod adds invisible light blocks [1-15].
body:
This mod adds invisible light blocks [1-15].
## Attention
❗ **In this version of the mod, light blocks do not have a hitbox, which is why the block can ~~ONLY~~ be removed using the command [/setblock x y z air]** ❗

**Since version 0.6, you can delete a block by pressing the F10 key, the legs must be in the block**

## Installation
1. Download and install Forge
2. Download the mod file
3. Copy in .minecraft\mods
